query: How many organisations are currently listed as signatories on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice signatory page (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/ai-code-practice) as of July 2026? List the count and names if possible.
answer:
I've completed the research. 

**Bottom line:** As of the July 2026 window, the official EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice signatory page lists **23 organisations** as full signatories (page last updated 23 April 2026):

Accexible, AI Studio Delta, Aleph Alpha, Almawave, Amazon, Anthropic, Black Forest Labs, Bria AI, Cohere, Domyn, Dweve, Fastweb, Google, IBM, Lawise, LINAGORA, Microsoft, Mistral AI, Open Hippo, OpenAI, Pleias, ServiceNow, and WRITER.

**Key caveat:** xAI signed only the Safety and Security Chapter (using "alternative adequate means" for the other chapters) and is not counted among the 23 full signatories — which is why some secondary sources cite "24." The list is continuously updated, so the exact figure can drift, but 23 is the most recent official count I could confirm for the July 2026 window.
